A LITTLE REASSURANCE

Good questions.
Clear answers.

Feel more prepared for your first step.

Plan your visit ↗
What happens at my first appointment?+

You’ll have time to talk about your symptoms, health history, and goals. Your physiotherapist can then assess your movement, explain their findings, and discuss suitable next steps with you.

What should I wear?+

Wear comfortable clothing that lets you move easily. Depending on the area being assessed, shorts or a vest may be useful. You can discuss any comfort or privacy preferences before your assessment.

Do I need to know which treatment to choose?+

No. Choose an initial physiotherapy assessment if you’re unsure. Your assessment is an opportunity to discuss your needs and which approach may be suitable.

Will I be given exercises to do at home?+

Your plan may include exercises tailored to your goals and circumstances. Your physiotherapist will explain how to do them and discuss how they fit into your routine.

How many appointments will I need?+

This varies with your needs, symptoms, and goals. Your physiotherapist can discuss a suggested plan after your assessment and review it with you as you progress.
